name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Adoption, Account Health, Renewals & Expansion | B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success manager who owns the relationship from onboarding through renewal and expansion. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 partners and kept all but one by tracking utilization, spotting risk early, and stepping in before they disengaged. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets. At Accelo I worked with C-suite and operations leads to map complex workflows onto a CRM and project platform. I run business reviews, coordinate escalations across product and support, and document every commitment.

Identify expansion opportunities and scope complementary services aligned with each client's goals.
Train owners and staff on every system, and document every interaction, goal, timeline, and deliverable in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion.
Report performance on a regular cadence with recommendations, backed by dashboards tracking results.

Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, and fed structured feedback to Product and Engineering.
